newsitem.title: USA: Immunex to market generic drug in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Immunex to market generic drug in Canada.

text.p: Immunex Corp said Tuesday it received approval to market a generic version of the chemotherapy drug Paclitaxel, in Canada.

It will be the first generic form of the drug to be marketed in North America. Currently paclitaxel is marketed exclusively by Bristol-Myers Squibb Co, under the trademark Taxol. The generic form of the drug to be marketed by Immunex is manufactured by American Home Products.

Immunex said it plans to announce its Canadian marketing partner and launch date for paclitaxel shortly. It also plans to file an Amended New Drug Application (ANDA) with the Food and Drug Administration for U.S. marketing approval, shortly after Bristol Meyers exclusivity ends at the end of 1997.
Paclitaxel is currently approved for treating refractory ovarian and refractory breast cancers, those forms of the disease that have not responded to other chemotherapy agents.
Immunex said sales of Bristol Myers' Taxol in Canada are estimated at about $20 million in 1996. U.S. sales in 1996 are estimated at $500 million.
Immunex did not disclose terms of the profit sharing arrangement between it and American Home Products.
